posts.title: Writing from K3
posts.description: After near-emergency open-heart at Papworth two and a half weeks ago, I am back across the road on the cardiac ward K3 in Addenbrooke’s hospital. The surgery went very well according to the medics, and left me in remarkable little discomfort. I am back in Addenbrooke’s for perhaps another four weeks because I still need six-times-a-day intravenous antibiotics to clear residual pockets of infection

posts.title: Timothy Smiley, 1930-2026
posts.description: Sad news that the logician and philosopher Timothy Smiley died earlier this week in Cambridge, a few days before his 96th birthday. Timothy was still working a little on logic and philosophy a year ago, and friends tell me he kept his wits and an interest in events to the last. The end of an era. And I, in particular, must owe my whole career to him.
